Subject: MAP launchpad template + weekly runbook (initial draft)

Hi Alice / Bob —

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, I put together an initial MAP (Mutual Action Plan) "launchpad" you can review with your stakeholders. The goal here is to give a compact, week-by-week playbook that ties technical validation (sample workloads + acceptance tests) to stakeholder approvals and procurement milestones.

What's included in this draft:
- Week 0: sandbox access + data connectivity checklist
- Week 1–2: pilot integration and latency/quality smoke tests
- Week 3–4: user acceptance + performance signoff + procurement checkpoint
- Owners: engineering, security, product, procurement lanes

I've attached: MAP-launchpad-template.gdoc (editable) and a companion slide skeleton MAP-weekly-runbook.gslides. Can you review with your engineering and procurement leads and send any tweaks by EOD Wednesday so we can finalize and lock a workshop slot?

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm two stakeholders we should include in the kickoff workshop (technical + procurement)
2) Tell us preferred workshop date (we have Tue/Thu next week open)
3) Share any hard constraints on pilot data residency or audit logging requirements

Attachment(s): MAP-launchpad-template.gdoc (Google Doc stub), MAP-weekly-runbook.gslides (Slides stub)

Best,
Sofia Ivanova

- Procurement: Tom Gillespie (tom.g@acmehealth.com) — he needs a high-level SLA + estimated commit for pilot GPUs.

Alice / team —

Great — Thu 11/19 10:00am PT works for us. I've added a short evaluation checklist to the doc to make acceptance criteria explicit (artifact owners + pass/fail checks). Key items I added:
- Data connection: sample file ingest + end-to-end inference run (engineer owner)
- Latency target: p95 < 300ms for 128-token inference (SLA draft)
- Output quality: 3 prompt sets + expected example outputs for regression checks
- Security: SOC 2 checklist items + required evidence owners

I've attached our evaluation matrix (evaluation-checklist.xlsx) and dropped a link into the MAP doc for visibility. If Acme can confirm the three prompt sets we'd like to use, we can wire up the automated eval pipeline to run nightly during the pilot.

Attachment(s): evaluation-checklist.xlsx
